product_name_specific: FFP2 R D Wiederverwendbare Maske mit Nano-Technologie
risk_description: After washing, the particle/filter retention capacity of the material reduces significantly (measured values: as low as 69%). Furthermore, the product contains erroneous indications regarding its use, reducing its protective function. Consequently, the product does not fulfil the health and safety requirements; thus, even if combined with other recommended measures, it may not properly protect.
legal_provision: The product does not comply with the Personal Protective Equipment Regulation nor with the European standard EN 149.
